subject.title: refactor(gateway): split chat handlers by workflow

question: Does the gateway owner approve this extraction after confirming that chat send ACK, detached dispatch, terminalization, history visibility, and background title behavior remain unchanged across the new module boundaries?
rationale: Focused tests and static guards are valuable but do not establish that the refactor preserves the coupled runtime lifecycle; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Approve after lifecycle review
options.body: Review the extracted handler boundaries and accept the refactor once a redacted real gateway chat send/history run demonstrates unchanged behavior.

options.title: Request a narrower extraction
options.body: Ask for the send lifecycle or history projection to remain together if the new ownership split makes the invariants harder to audit.

recommendation.title: Approve after lifecycle review
recommendation.body: Review the extracted handler boundaries and accept the refactor once a redacted real gateway chat send/history run demonstrates unchanged behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the available context identifies them as the person currently driving this gateway refactor.
